limitations: Published address spans are selected reconstructed resource ranges, not a complete catalog of every game asset.
Resource spans may represent shared resources or collections; they are not distinct in-game object counts.
Address ends are exclusive. Embedded padding positions are not described by this summary.
Resource IDs identify this snapshot and are not stable game IDs.
ROM shares are storage measurements, not gameplay or semantic completion.
Raw assets, code, implementation details and private working material are not distributed.
Pure C selected spans include non-additive linker veneers. Storage accounting is distinct from recovered original functions and gameplay completion.

original_byte_dependency.note: Includes retained original suffixes, code, data, assets and padding; not the number of unknown code bytes.

latest_milestone.title: Mission candidate collection and replacement integrated
latest_milestone.summary: Twenty-two actual-image cases pass, including two independently derived counterexamples that rejected the earlier implementation. The accepted C preserves the original state ownership and distinct replacement continuations.
latest_milestone.remaining: The method is behavior-accepted for controlled cases and integrated, but not a whole-function exact match. Natural mission lifecycle, unrestricted producer domains and physical hardware remain unproved.

tooling_history.title: Local method build and indexing service
tooling_history.status: Historical tooling acceptance: 90 focused tests passed. Warm comparison 0.408 s; separate client plus strict preflight 1.463 s. These are stage measurements, not current whole-method delivery rates.
tooling_history.scope: Per-method C/ASM comparison, dependency-bound caches, automatic manifest indexing, stale-input checks and two parallel requests. Local iteration has no full-ROM disassembly dependency; independent behavior and final ROM acceptance remain separate.

tooling_history.title: Measured production build throughput
tooling_history.status: Integrated tooling: warm full build 88.332 s to 49.651 s (1.78x); 131 focused tests passed. Identical accepted image.
tooling_history.scope: 11,006 cached modules; same inputs and toolchain. Input and artifact validation remain enabled. This timing is full-build execution, not end-to-end game recovery throughput.

active_work.title: Core recovery

delivery_metrics.scope: This one method; gross13:49:45UTC to17:26:47UTC includes repair, failures, profile transition and handoff gaps. Historical exact milestone has its own denominator.

daily.scope: Calendar days in Asia/Shanghai, using original credit occurrence times and currently unrevoked receipts. Range unions deduplicate overlaps within each gate. Cumulative curves cover dated ledger receipts only; the current ROM baseline is never backdated. Missing historical receipts are unknown, not zero recovery. Integration is a separate gate and must not be added to local exact. Current day is partial; no projection. Eligible mixed and pure C remain separate.
